notes: 41 items after the owner's review and close-ups
12 voice notes and 3 typed notes on 14 items
Area is estimated from the photos: about 4.2 x 3.7 m, a terrazzo floor, one bed, an L desk and an almirah along the walls.
There are no bookshelves. The 11 books stand in one row on the desk. The almirah probably has internal shelves, but none were photographed.
The monitor's model sticker is unreadable and no screen shows the resolution, so the resolution is unknown. It is priced as a 24 inch FHD IPS Acer Nitro equivalent.
The Carrier AC and the Uppercase suitcase still have protective film on them, so both look recently bought.
Electrical safety: the old wooden switchboard has a scorched socket, and the MCB box (dated 2014) has loose exposed wiring. The insurer may want these fixed.
A mattress probably sits under the bedsheet but none is visible, so it is not listed.
The router looks ISP-supplied and may be the provider's property.

The second, natural-wood panel door is seen only behind the chair; confirm it belongs to this room. A louvred wooden shutter to its right may be a cupboard or a door to the next room, and is not listed.
Small items not listed: sticky notes, a broom, footwear under the almirah, and a black remote of unknown make (the Carrier AC remote is counted with the AC).
Building fixtures (2 doors, 2 windows) are listed separately from contents, as the building policy requires. The switchboards and the MCB box are also fixed wiring.
